title: Yellow Fever Virus Replication in Cell Culture
author: Izabela M Rezende
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pw6dphe

steps.title: Prepare and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare a cell suspension of C6/36 cells for inoculation.

substeps.instruction: Remove and discard the cell culture media from the culture vessel.
Wash cells using PBS (approximately 2 mL per 10 cm2 culture surface area) by gently adding the solution to the side of the vessel opposite the attached cell layer.
Resuspend the cells in a minimal volume of pre-warmed Leibovit’z with 5% BFS by shaking the flask slightly and using a pipette.
Determine the number of cells/mL using a cell counter and adjust the concentration to 65,000 C6/36 cells/mL.

steps.title: Inoculate Cells
steps.instruction: Seed the cells into culture tubes and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 100,000 C6/36 cells in 1.5 mL of Leibovit’z medium supplemented with 5% BFS into the bottom of a cell culture tube.
Incubate the tubes inclined at 45 degrees at 28°C.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Viral Adsorption
steps.instruction: Remove media and wash cells prior to inoculation.

substeps.instruction: After 12-16 hours, remove and discard the media using a sterile pipette.
Wash the cells twice with phosphate buffered saline.

steps.title: Perform Viral Adsorption
steps.instruction: Inoculate the cells with the viral solution and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of a solution containing 20 µL of sera and 80 µL of Leibovit’z medium.
Incubate the cells for 1 hour at 28°C.

steps.title: Post-Adsorption Incubation
steps.instruction: Provide maintenance medium and monitor for cytopathic effect.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of Leibovit’z medium supplemented with 2% BFS and incubate the cells at 28°C.
Observe the cells daily using an inverted microscope until cytopathic effect is observed or up to 10 days.

steps.title: Harvest and Store Supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the viral supernatant for storage or analysis.

substeps.instruction: Divide into aliquots and store at -70°C for use in further blind passages, RNA extraction, or molecular analysis.
